scope: Existing portrait, source-only coarse single-annotator silhouette and fixed quantized-depth subject anchor diagnostic; not held-out, raw-depth parity, human effort or product readiness
sampling: floor(anchor * width/height), one 8bit grayscale sample; inclusive clipped +/-20 band
referenceRasterization: even-odd polygon interior at pixel centers; union outer polygons then remove background holes
interpretation: differentPixels is the minimum binary label flips to this coarse reference, not strokes, time, ease of correcting depth, or total editing effort; all-subject/empty are synthetic binary-mask baselines
tuning: No post-output protocol, annotation, anchor or band changes; retain all results
